title: Teach Yourself Malay: Practical Speaking Course
description: A modern, speaking-first A1-B2 Malay course adapted from the rights-holder-supplied Teach Yourself Malay source. It follows the source progression from pronunciation and introductions through family, work, travel, hotels, shopping, food, leisure, and healthcare. Spelling, currency, technology, and scenarios are updated for present-day Malaysian usage.
